Velocity Cruise Control for Mechanical CableThrottle Bodies


From Dakota Digital

Elevate your driving experience with Dakota Digital's latest innovation! Adding cruise control to your vehicle is now easier than ever. Dakota Digital's new VCM-200 and VCM-300 series cruise controls is a perfect fit for your Mechanical Cable operated throttle body. Say goodbye to uncertainty with our intuitive setup wizard that effortlessly guides you through installation; ensuring the smoothest and most reliable cruise operation on the market.

Main Features:

  • Compatible with Mechanical Cable throttle bodies.
    • VCM-200 series includes the SEN-01-4160 pass thru speed sensor for use with most cable driven speedometers with 7/8-x18 or 5/8- x18 threaded connection on either the transmission or speedometer side of your speedometer cable.
    • VCM-300 series are designed for installation with Dakota Digital instrument systems or most electronically drive speedometers or VSS signals.
      • Add the SEN-4165 Magnetic Drive Shaft Speed sensor to the VCM-300 series for any application where a VSS signal is not available or the SEN-01-4160 pass thru speed sender will not work.
  • Ability to learn both OE and aftermarket cruise handles and pedals for maximum compatibility.
  • Configurable with the Dakota Digital App, featuring a built-in setup wizard and troubleshooting wizard.
  • Monitors speed and tach information through the Aux BIM connection on your Dakota Digital Instruments or directly from a speed and tach connection.
  • Seven-segment display and integrated LEDs for setup and diagnostics.
  • Output to drive any cruise Indicator.
  • Plug-and-play compatible with LED tail lights.
  • Dozens of safety features built in to provide you with the most reliable cruise system on the market

Cruise Handles

  • Compatible with all resistive and non-resistive switches, both OEM and aftermarket handles.

Speed and Tach Interface Options

  • Plug and Play with Dakota Digital Instrument systems via the Aux I/O connection. (plastic control boxes only)
  • Direct speed and tach connections.
  • User configurable CAN messages (250k-1M baud, standard and extended ID).

Setup and Troubleshooting

  • Configurable with the Dakota Digital App, featuring a built-in setup wizard and troubleshooting wizard.
